item_name: Rothco Two Ring Baton & Flashlight Holder
item_short_desc: Rothco’s 2 Ring Baton & Flashlight Holder is designed to provide police and public safety professionals with an efficient, durable solution for carrying essential gear. Featuring 2 sturdy plastic rings, this holder can securely hold a baton, flashlight, or other compatible items, ensuring they are within reach at all times. Made with strong polypropylene webbing, the holder is built to support the weight of your duty gear without sagging or loosening.
description: Rothco’s 2 Ring Baton & Flashlight Holder is designed to provide police and public safety professionals with an efficient, durable solution for carrying essential gear. Featuring 2 sturdy plastic rings, this holder can securely hold a baton, flashlight, or other compatible items, ensuring they are within reach at all times. Made with strong polypropylene webbing, the holder is built to support the weight of your duty gear without sagging or loosening. It attaches easily to any duty belt up to 2.25 inches wide using a hook & loop closure reinforced with 2 snaps, providing extra stability. Whether you're on patrol or responding to an emergency, this baton and flashlight holder keeps your tools organized and accessible, allowing you to focus on the task at hand.
